messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident P-97321 triggered — inference-gateway.euw1 5xx-rate spike (5m window >4%). Auto-escalation to on-call.

pagerduty: Incident P-97321 created, high urgency. Paging rotation: maria -> tom -> kai.

maria: @pagerduty acknowledged. Taking initial triage :eyes:

maria: seeing 5xx% at ~6.3%, latency up from 80ms to 480ms. Most errors are 502 / upstream timeout.

tom: joining. Any customer-facing errors reported? @customer-success?

customer-success: got one report — a workspace sync failure for customer acme-inc, quickly opened CS ticket.

sasha: quick metric check — traffic from eu-west1 and eu-central. Error-rate concentrated on requests with header "X-Client-Prefix: mobile-"; might be KV cache missstorm.

kai: runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-gateway-5xx>

kai: initial mitigation: scale gateway pool, enable fallback routing to dedicated-1, and warm kv-cache. Running:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/inference-gateway --replicas=6
curl -XPOST https://ops-api/route/enable-fallback -d '{"target":"dedicated-1"}'
```

maria: executed scale command, replicas -> 6 :white_check_mark: logs show backend A returning 502s at ~50% of error samples.

tom: toggled fallback routing, traffic shifted ~18% to dedicated-1, 5xx% dropping to 2.1%.

kai: temporary mitigation effective. Next steps: trace upstream auth-proxy, check recent deploys. @sasha can you grep logs for 502 stack traces and deploy tags?

sasha: grep done — auth-proxy v2.14.3 had increased error rate starting 1743219500. No deploy in last hour scheduled, maybe config push.

maria: PagerDuty: acknowledged by maria at 1743219999, escalated to kai at 1743220080.

tom: preparing oncall handoff to kai in 10m. I'll stay until handoff complete.

kai: taking over. I'll open a short incident channel and coordinate rollback if needed. Setting severity->SEV2.

incident-bot: Auto-suppression applied to noisy heartbeat alerts. Notifying infra team for auth-proxy investigation.

kai: deciding to roll back auth-proxy to v2.14.2 for EU cluster. Rolling now.

sasha: rollback submitted, monitoring.

maria: 5xx% down to 0.6% over last 3m, latencies normalizing. CS updated acme-inc.

tom: great. Keep monitoring for 30m; let's not close P-97321 until confirmed stable and postmortem planned.

kai: agreed. Postmortem owner: kai. Action items: rollback root cause RCA, improve canary gating for auth-proxy, add KV-cache warm loop for bursty prefixes.

incident-bot: P-97321 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Will auto-close if stable for 60m. :confetti_ball:
